blockingLoop.evidence: 'Could you tell me a bit more about what it is doing, and when it happens?' after the customer had already said only the light failed

rationale: The first reply was good: isolate, cool, use an oven-rated bulb, and check the old bulb. The second reply asked a vague question the customer had already answered. The third reply escalated to an engineer, although a bulb swap is a safe DIY job. It never said to remove the lens cover, read the old bulb's rating (E14 25W 300C), or replace it, so the escalation was premature and unhelpful, and the customer's question went unanswered.
